lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A clear matrix of high-luminance circular blobs arranged in roughly vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. The spots show a regular spatial distribution on the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of spots, creating a grid-like arrangement of high-contrast nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three horizontal longitudinal ridges are visible along the upper flank, defined by a sharp intensity gradient with light pixels on the dorsal side of the ridge and shadowed pixels below.

other_distinctive_markers: Densely packed high-luminance small spots on the left pectoral fin; several commensal fish (remoras) are visible in the surrounding water column near the ventral and lateral surfaces.
